# Colophon {.unnumbered}

This book was written in Quarto using the `cosmo` theme with
local overrides in `practicum.scss`. R code is executed by
`knitr` and rendered with `downlit` for function-level
hyperlinks.

Body text is set in Source Sans 3 (fallbacks Inter,
Helvetica Neue, Arial); headings and UI in the same face;
code in JetBrains Mono (fallbacks Fira Mono, Menlo). Syntax
highlighting uses the accessibility-tuned `arrow` palette,
consistent between HTML and PDF output.

PDF output is produced by `xelatex` with the `scrbook`
document class at 6.5 × 9 inches. The PDF monofont is
DejaVu Sans Mono for complete Unicode coverage of
box-drawing and mathematical glyphs.

The prose, figures, and exercises are licensed CC BY 4.0. Code
blocks printed in the text are MIT; the package code and build
scripts are GPL-3. Third-party images are excluded from both and
carry their own terms, recorded in [Credits](credits.qmd). The
full statement is in `LICENSE.md`.

Source available at <https://github.com/rgt47/practicum>.

## Build environment

The lockfile `renv.lock` at the root of the repository records
the package versions the book is meant to be built with. It
records intentions, not what happened. This edition was built
against the R library installed on the build machine, not a
library restored from the lockfile, and the repository contains
no Dockerfile for the book, so neither the operating system nor
the system libraries are pinned. That gap is what @sec-renv and
@sec-docker teach you to close.

The tables below record what was actually used. They are
generated by R when this page is executed, not typed, so they
cannot drift from the build they describe. Because the book is
rendered with Quarto's `freeze` option, they describe the last
render in which this page was executed.

A 'no' in the last column of @tbl-colophon-packages is a finding,
not a typo. Either this edition was built with a version other
than the one the lockfile records, or the lockfile does not record
the package at all. In both cases a reader who restores the
lockfile will not get the environment that produced this book,
which is the silent failure habit 4 exists to make loud.
